description: This file declares functions, structures, enums, and macros for network interface management, including IP configuration, VLAN, bridge, neighbor, and routing operations, used in network-related software components.

methods.name: file_write
methods.description: Writes buffer to a specified file.

methods.name: file_read
methods.description: Reads data from a specified file into buffer.

methods.name: vlan_create
methods.description: Creates a VLAN interface with given name and VLAN ID.

methods.name: vlan_delete
methods.description: Deletes a VLAN interface by name.

methods.name: bridge_create
methods.description: Creates a network bridge with specified name.

methods.name: bridge_delete
methods.description: Deletes a network bridge by name.

methods.name: bridge_set_stp
methods.description: Enables or disables Spanning Tree Protocol on a bridge.

methods.name: interface_add_to_bridge
methods.description: Adds an interface to a bridge.

methods.name: interface_remove_from_bridge
methods.description: Removes an interface from a bridge.

methods.name: bridge_get_info
methods.description: Retrieves information about a bridge.

methods.name: bridge_free_info
methods.description: Frees resources associated with bridge info.

methods.name: interface_up
methods.description: Brings a network interface up.

methods.name: interface_down
methods.description: Brings a network interface down.

methods.name: interface_set_mtu
methods.description: Sets the MTU for a network interface.

methods.name: interface_set_flags
methods.description: Sets flags on a network interface.

methods.name: interface_get_mac
methods.description: Retrieves MAC address of an interface.

methods.name: interface_set_mac
methods.description: Sets MAC address of an interface.

methods.name: interface_exist
methods.description: Checks if an interface exists.

methods.name: interface_set_netmask
methods.description: Sets netmask for an interface.

methods.name: interface_get_ip
methods.description: Gets IP address of an interface.

methods.name: interface_rename
methods.description: Renames a network interface.

methods.name: interface_delete
methods.description: Deletes a network interface.

methods.name: interface_get_stats
methods.description: Retrieves statistics for a network interface.

methods.name: addr_add
methods.description: Adds IP address configuration to an interface.

methods.name: addr_delete
methods.description: Deletes IP address configuration from an interface.

methods.name: addr_derive_broadcast
methods.description: Derives broadcast address from IP and prefix.

methods.name: route_add
methods.description: Adds a route to the routing table.

methods.name: route_delete
methods.description: Deletes a route from the routing table.

methods.name: rule_add
methods.description: Adds a policy routing rule.

methods.name: rule_delete
methods.description: Deletes a policy routing rule.

methods.name: tunnel_add_ip4ip6
methods.description: Creates an IPv4/IPv6 tunnel interface.

methods.name: neighbour_delete
methods.description: Deletes an entry from neighbor table.

methods.name: neighbour_get_list
methods.description: Lists neighbor table entries.
